test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: Which one of the following statements about the 15th Fifteenth Finance Commission is NOT correct?

options.text: The 15th Fifteenth Finance Commission was appointed by the Government of India in November 27, 2017.
Sri N.K. Singh is its Chairman.
The recommendations of the commission will cover the five year period 2021-26.
The commission has been asked to submit its report by August 30, 2020.

solution:
The correct answer is __**option 4.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Finance Commission is a constitutional body formed by the President of India to give suggestions on center-state financial relations.
 
• The chairman of the 15th Finance Commission of India N.K. Singh. **Hence, option 2 is correct.**
 
• The Fifteenth Finance Commission was constituted on **27 November 2017** against the backdrop of the abolition of the Planning Commission. Hence, option 1 is correct.
 
• 15th Finance Commission submits its Report for 2021-22 to 2025-26 to President Ram Nath Kovind** by October 30, 2020. **Hence, option 3 is correct and option 4 is NOT correct.
